outcome: borderline/clinical range Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) scores
cohort: The study included 94 children with prenatal opioid exposure evaluated with the CBCL at age 2 years.
finding: Lower Bayley-III motor scores and discharge home with mother with safety plan were associated with borderline/clinical Externalizing Problems, while medication treatment for neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome was associated with normal scores in opioid-exposed children.
